review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.note: Achievable in strictly primitives via class CSS. Panel=.mat-mdc-autocomplete-panel (unstyled under setUnstyledMode → card: width/r12/bg/shadow/padding). Row=.velt-autocomplete-option--container (gap/pad/r8; active=.mat-mdc-option-active → #f1efec). Avatar=.velt-autocomplete-option-icon .velt-user-avatar (32px default; override width/height + --legacy-velt-user-avatar-* to 20px + r999 + border). Name=.velt-autocomplete-option-name. Email=.velt-autocomplete-option-description (hide for single-line rows). Measured pixel-clean.

learnings.why: VeltCommentComposer (page-mode) renders NO Cancel affordance (hasCancelButton:false, measured) + a voice/video/screen-record toolbar, and a one-way velt-composer-open expansion (42->82px). The design's minimal [Cancel | send] 2-row typing layout needs VeltCommentComposerWireframe.
